{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id and sample_seq
print("Number of rows before deduplication:", len(trial_df))

# Keep only the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient_id
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

print("Number of rows after deduplication:", len(trial_df))

# Verify that patient_id is now unique
print("Are patient_ids unique after deduplication?", trial_df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum() == 0)"}
